He expressed confusion as he has valid identification including voter ID and Aadhar card. The Election Commission is conducting a Special Intensive Revision for voter list updates. They have extended deadlines for filing claims in Delhi and Maharashtra as part of this effort.

banking-economy.title: HSBC makes big push for affluent clients in India to fuel growth
banking-economy.summary: HSBC Holdings Plc plans to expand its operations in India by increasing its branch network by 35% over the next two years. The bank aims to become one of the top private banks in India by 2030, focusing on wealth management and transaction banking. HSBC is also targeting affluent customers whose interests span globally to strengthen its international network.

sectors.title: Gemini can now call businesses for you: Unboxing Google’s new AI feature
sectors.summary: Google is set to roll out its Call for Me feature in the Gemini app for selected users. This feature allows users to automate calls to businesses and check services like prices and hours. Users must be 18 or older, possess a Pixel 11 device, and have a paid subscription. Initially, limits will be placed on the number of calls made each day.
